import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();rules=root/'scripts/gmyhf_statement_fixes.py';pipe=root/'scripts/repair_gmyhf_sample_findings.py'
originals={rules:rules.read_text(),pipe:pipe.read_text()}
cases=[
(rules,'窗口长度差一','k=len(a)-len(out)+1','k=len(a)-len(out)+2','StatementFixTests.test_missing_window_size_is_unique_and_verified'),
(rules,'不验证推导窗口的输出',' and [max(a[i:i+k]) for i in range(len(a)-k+1)]==out','','StatementFixTests.test_missing_window_size_is_unique_and_verified'),
(rules,'样例不修财富下界','shift=max(0,m-min(a))','shift=0','StatementFixTests.test_wealth_sample_translation_keeps_minimum_gap'),
(rules,'仍保留反向人数约束',"replace(old,'1 <= K <= N <= 10^6')","replace(old,'1 <= N <= K <= 10^6')",'StatementFixTests.test_meeting_and_pass_change_only_the_conflicting_clause'),
(rules,'仍强制Pass骰子点数','Pass可省略掷骰点数','Pass须提供掷骰点数','StatementFixTests.test_meeting_and_pass_change_only_the_conflicting_clause'),
(pipe,'覆盖历史第4批回执',"'gmyhf-sample-repairs.json' if batch==4 else 'gmyhf-statement-repairs-batch8.json'","'gmyhf-sample-repairs.json'",'FollowupWriterTests.test_batch_selection_readback_retry_and_historical_receipt'),
(pipe,'未绑定上一批财富数据',"if number in (30205,25685):\n            prior", "if number==30205:\n            prior",'FollowupWriterTests.test_previous_data_repair_is_bound_before_wealth_sample_update'),
(pipe,'只读模式仍写平台','    if not apply:return','    if False:return','FollowupWriterTests.test_followup_default_readonly_and_drift_guard')]
cases.append((pipe,'参考不匹配原样例仍放行',"require(sha(answer.encode())==expected,","require(True,",'StatementFixTests.test_missing_parameter_sample_cannot_change_the_original_output'))
results=[]
try:
 for path,name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert originals[path].count(old)==1,(name,originals[path].count(old))
  path.write_text(originals[path].replace(old,new))
  p=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_statement_fixes.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert p.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':p.returncode})
  path.write_text(originals[path])
finally:
 for path,source in originals.items():path.write_text(source)
source=Path(__file__).read_text()
(root/'collab/gmyhf-statement-repairs-batch8-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':8,'results':results,'procedure_source':source,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(results),'种题面变异全部检出，源码已恢复')
